reviews.t: ... my healing tattoos and it doesn't bleed out color like other things in the past have done
reviews.x: I use this on my healing tattoos and it doesn't bleed out color like other things in the past have done. I also use it on my 6 month olds excema and it heals it within a couple of days! I try to apply it at least once a day on him to prevent any excema from popping up and he is SO soft!

reviews.t: It is just a protector - Vaseline is as well for less money.
reviews.x: Wish I had done a better job of reading!  My BAD!  Active ingredient is 41% Petroleum, Vaseline is 100% at a lower cost!  Thought there was something else in it that made it a "Healing Ointment", it is just a protector.

reviews.t: Pharmacist recommended!  I've recommended it many times as a pharmacist and use it myself.
reviews.x: Aquaphor Healing Ointment is one of the best ointments you could buy, with or without a prescription.  It has many uses, from dry skin to minor burns and cuts.  The petrolatum in Aquaphor along with some of the other ingredients provide a nice skin barrier which can be used even in sensitive skin areas and helps retain moisture and promotes faster healing.  Aquaphor's petrolatum is oil based and as a result, it protects skin better than water based products.  While it does go on a little greasy

reviews.t: Absolutely amazing product!
reviews.x: Have had this around the house since I was a kid, but never knew its REAL healing power until I woke up one night, screaming from the pain of a bedsore and very dry, very thin skin around the tailbone. After soaking in the tub, I slathered this on, and continued to do so for a week, by which time everything cleared up. However, I continue to use it on a daily basis, since I'm still pretty much bed-bound and need the continued protection. I am NOT making any medical claims with this review, howev

reviews.t: Very effective for dry skin and Psoriasis
reviews.x: I have very dry skin and Psoriasis and this helps so much. Not only does it help with the dry cracking skin on my hands and elbows but the Psoriasis scales, redness, and itching on my arms are significantly lessened and clear faster. I am very sensitive to chemicals and this does not bother me like many other products and there is no fragrance which is a major plus. I purchased it in the tubes first then went back for this larger container, even though I only have to use a small amount I use it

reviews.t: Aquaphor rocks
reviews.x: What can I say?  My dermatologist told me years ago that Aquaphor helps almost everything, and I agree.  I'm old,  live in a cold climate,  and have lots of skin issues, but as long as I keep dabbing on the Aquaphor--rubbing a small amount on my hands before bed (I do don food-safe plastic gloves but I only have to do this perhaps twice a week); putting a dab on a troublesome corn every morning; putting a touch on something that's not healing or a place that's sore.  And, of course, I can buy it

reviews.t: It is a good moisturizer for those with dry skin
reviews.x: I use this in the winter after bathing or showering.  It is a good moisturizer for those with dry skin.  It is also good just to wear as a first base of moisture before adding whatever lotion or scents you have because it is unscented.  Feels good on the skin, easy to use, just rub a dab in your hand and apply.  Good deal.

reviews.t: Great Product!!!
reviews.x: I love this product it really works!!! My doctor recommended this for me. It has helped so much!!! I take prescription water pills and get very dried out!!! What a difference it has made!!! I would recommend this to anyone who has dry Skin issues!!!

reviews.t: Aquafor
reviews.x: I have used this product for ten years since my radiation therapy after chemo.  It works !  Recommended by radiation oncologist.

reviews.t: Review
reviews.x: My doctor told me use it after radiation burns

reviews.t: Plastic Jar Gets Oily After Using to Close Then Slippery Open Next Usage
reviews.x: Best for cracked and chapped hands and blistery fingers due to constant cleaning and handiwork. I garden a lot and also an overzealous hand-washer. This stuff is expensive but it works well to heal the cracked fingers. But still cannot use my phone fingerprint security as my fingers composition alters too much from chapped to heal but then back to chapped again. Only complaint is that I really do not like the  plastic jar with turning cap. Prefer the tube. Seriously, why would you want to get oi

reviews.t: Purchased product is not the same as through retailer
reviews.x: I just opened the jar and immediately noted that the contents were yellow to orange and were not level throughout the jar.  I've used this product for years so realize there is some variance in consistency and color, but this was unlike any change I'd ever seen.  The product looked old or possibly exposed to heat.  The expiration date on the label is 10/2023; LOT 14478025BP so all seems good with the manufacturer.  I'll go to Walmart this week for a replacement as I'm nearly out of ointment in m

reviews.t: Great Healing Power
reviews.x: Honestly, I use this on my dog. Without this, her nose is super crusty like rough sandpaper. And I use it on her foot pads that dry and crack. Within a week of use, there was a significant improvement on the deep cracks. And now they only require occasional applications for maintenance.  I tried all the pet-related products but Aquaphor always worked best. I leave the large tub in my bathroom counter and many guests have commented how much they liked it. I don't mention it's for my dog.

reviews.t: Amazing Price For The Size!
reviews.x: Aquaphor first of all is AMAZING! It is great for babies and we use use it for our elderly father.  It moisturizes and toughens up his thin, sensitive, easily bruised skin. This 14oz jar is a great find for a great price. No more spending the same amount for tubes 2oz or less.  One more benefit to the jar versus the squeezable tube is the ease of getting and applying it and not getting it all over the tube. LOVE!!! NO MORE DRUG STORE PRICES!!!

reviews.t: The best moisturizer in the world!!!
reviews.x: The best moisturizer in the world!!!  Not only does it moisturize amazingly, it also assists with healing of small wounds, burns and the like.  I had a mole cluster removed and used this product from day one home...no scar is noted and the area was over a cm in width!  We have it on hand at all times and use daily.  (additionally, I am an RN...seen and used a lot of products in my life...LOVE this one!)

reviews.t: The best for cracked and dry heels
reviews.x: I have never found anything else that works as well as Aquafor for dry, cracked heels and dry hands.  I live in Colorado, which is very dry, so hands and feet suffer here, especially in the cold winter.  Granted, the product is greasy and sticky feeling, but I only use it at night.  It works particularly well on my feet at night if I wear lightweight socks after applying it.

reviews.t: This is 41% petroleum. Instead of this, just buy the much cheaper petroleum jelly.
reviews.x: double check whether or not you want ointment or cream. Unpleasantly surprised that this is an ointment and not the usual cream I used. This ointment is very very greasy! It is almost like applying auto lube grease! This is 41% petroleum. Instead of this, just buy the much cheaper petroleum jelly. The cheap petroleum jelly is much easier to apply!

reviews.t: Works great to soften and get rid of chapped skin overnight
reviews.x: Works great to soften and get rid of chapped skin overnight. I find it too greasy to use during the day, but it's fine for overnight (and especially good if you have some cotton gloves and can really slather it on). It's good for putting on your feet after a shower too, just wear some socks or you'll leave greasy footprints.

reviews.t: Lifesaver
reviews.x: I work in the healthcare field so I am always washing my hands. I already have sensitive skin that is prone to dryness so this plus excessive handwashing and seasonal dryness leads to my skin to almost bleed from dryness. This ointment is a life saver! It really absorbs into the skin to provide amazing moisture that lasts.

reviews.t: Wonderful for Dry Lips and Limbs
reviews.x: This is the best stuff I have ever used for dry lips. It instantly moisturizes them and keeps them moist for a long time. My children also use it on their arms and legs when their limbs feel dry. Because you only need to use this stuff sparingly, this big tub will last forever. Great value for a great product.

reviews.t: Does the job
reviews.x: Physical therapist recommended this to me.  Unfortunately, it has the consistency and look of petroleum jelly, which is the main ingredient.  Seems pretty expensive for that.  It does soften rough and chapped skin, so it does its job.  I also purchased Eucerin and I like it better.

reviews.t: Great for Lips and "Slugging"
reviews.x: I highly recommend this for people that "slug". Once you apply this and add the vasoline on top it is the perfect way to get ultra moisture. I also used it on my lips and it helps prevent and clear up any chapping. This is such a good price for the size of the jar you get.

reviews.t: Aquaphor(r) keeps your skin moisterised and helps with healing cracked skin
reviews.x: Not the first time for a review on this product.  It was recommended to me by a Wound Center of a major hospital for my legs which are always dry and scaly.  This ointment does wonders.  I can and usually do go through at least a tub a month.  Some months require two tubs.

reviews.t: Too thick and waxy. Sticks to clothing but not your skin.
reviews.x: I don't like this. It's too thick and waxy and just sits on your skin. If you apply it when your skin is still damp right after taking a shower, it won't still stick to your skin. Very hard to use and it sticks to your clothing. It isn't moisturizing either.

reviews.t: Thick thick thick
reviews.x: Much like petroleum jelly, very thick.  Good for skin that really (REALLY) needs help.  Use on my feet and hands sometimes, occasionally face.  You can get away with wearing during the daytime if you staying inside (ha!) - no,  just put on a very thin film.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise it as an effective moisturizer for very dry, cracked, and sensitive skin, including conditions like eczema and psoriasis.
Many say it helps heal minor wounds, burns, and skin irritation, and several note it was recommended by a doctor or pharmacist.
Some reviewers note it is expensive, and one criticizes it as essentially just a petroleum-based protector no better than cheaper Vaseline.
A few reviewers report issues with the product itself, such as an off color/consistency suggesting it was old, or a slippery, oily jar.
